xbar-sampling-panels.alt: Three histograms on the same axis from 0 to 14 minutes. Top: 20,000 simulated drive-through wait times, strongly skewed right, mean 4.19 and standard deviation 2.78. Middle: 5,000 means of samples of 4 cars, still skewed right, standard deviation 1.41. Bottom: 5,000 means of samples of 40 cars, bell shaped and narrow, standard deviation 0.439, close to 2.8 divided by the square root of 40. A dashed line marks the population mean 4.2 in every panel.
